name: Lakeway Commons
summary: Lakeway Commons is a 100,000 square foot mixed-use shopping center in Shrewsbury, Massachusetts, anchored by Whole Foods and featuring popular dining destinations like Tavern in the Square and Burtons Grill. This premier community destination offers convenient access from Route 9 with a thoughtfully curated mix of retail, dining, and lifestyle amenities.
demographics: Lakeway Commons attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from Shrewsbury and surrounding Central Massachusetts communities, with visitors typically in the 30-55 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area draws health-conscious shoppers seeking premium grocery options at Whole Foods, along with professionals and families looking for upscale casual dining experiences. The center serves as a convenient lifestyle destination for busy suburban residents who value quality retailers and dining in an accessible, well-maintained environment.
description: Lakeway Commons is a premier mixed-use shopping destination in Shrewsbury, Massachusetts, carrying on the community spirit that began with the work of Anthony "Spag" Borgatti (1916–1996), a beloved local merchant. This thoughtfully designed center combines grocery shopping, dining, and lifestyle options in one of Central Massachusetts' most thriving communities. The development features 100,000 square feet of retail space anchored by a 50,000 square foot Whole Foods Market, providing residents with premium grocery options and specialty foods. Beyond its grocery anchor, Lakeway Commons offers an impressive array of dining and retail tenants including Starbucks, Tavern in the Square, Burtons Grill, and SkinMd, creating a vibrant gathering place for the community. Located at 193 Boston Turnpike with convenient access from Route 9, the center features ample parking and easy navigation, making it a highly accessible destination for shoppers throughout the region.
